# wallpaper

## Where the image lives

The current wallpaper (the image bytes plus a `current.json` sidecar with its
mime and version) is stored at `apps/desktop/wallpaper/` — this plugin's area
inside the desktop meta-app's one data dir (`desktopDir.subdir("wallpaper")`,
from `@plugins/apps-core/data-dirs`). The wallpaper is part of the desktop, not
an app of its own, so it declares no data dir; see `apps-core/CLAUDE.md`. It
used to be the top-level `apps/wallpaper` dir, and `desktopDir`'s `movedFrom`
entry carries the move — `server/internal/store.ts` spells neither path.

  - **`upload`** — Upload wallpaper source: contributes the Upload tab to the desktop wallpaper picker, emitting a local image file the picker funnels through the upload endpoint.
